comparison.objective: Drive a curved needle through two pad slots along its arc and hand it to the other hand; candidate tunes a shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: PR requires curved-path insertion, tissue-respecting motion, precise bimanual handoff, and continuous retention. Candidate requires fine hex access, captive locking, collar adjustment, socket reacquisition, and iterative testing.
comparison.success_condition: PR requires correct entry/exit, ≥2 cm emergence, other-hand grasp, first-hand release, stability, and no tear, pad press, or drop. Candidate requires repeated safe axial stopping under numeric mechanical limits.
comparison.reason: Curved needle driving and handoff are unrelated to damper adjustment and commissioning.
